question: In which of the following months in 2024 did the Sahitya Akademi organise a two-day Birth Centenary Symposium on 'Prabhjot Kaur and Colonel Narinder Pal Singh'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3) October**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sahitya Akademi organised a two-day Birth Centenary Symposium in October 2024.
 
• The symposium was dedicated to 'Prabhjot Kaur and Colonel Narinder Pal Singh'.
 
• It marked the 100th birth anniversary of both distinguished personalities.
 
• The event featured discussions, readings, and tributes to their contributions to literature and society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahitya Akademi**:

 
 
• Established in 1954, it is India's National Academy of Letters.
 
• It promotes literature in 24 Indian languages, including English.
 
 
 
• **Prabhjot Kaur**:
 
 
• A renowned Punjabi writer known for her contributions to Punjabi literature.
 
• She authored several acclaimed novels, short stories, and poems.
 
 
 
• **Colonel Narinder Pal Singh**:
 
 
• A respected figure in Punjabi literature and military service.
 
• His works often reflect themes of patriotism and valor.
 
 
 
• **Birth Centenary Celebrations**:
 
 
• Such events commemorate the 100th birth anniversary of notable individuals.
 
• They often include symposiums, exhibitions, and publication releases.
